mapper.select: SELECT id, proc_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, created_at, deleted FROM tb_procedure_doc WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT TOP 1 d.id, d.proc_type, d.file_name, d.file_size, d.mime_type, d.uploaded_by, u.name AS uploader_name, d.created_at FROM tb_procedure_doc d LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = d.uploaded_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE d.proc_type = #{procType} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_procedure_doc ( proc_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{procType,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{filePath,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{fileSize,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{mimeType,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{uploadedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
